articles.headline: Hornets to retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey
articles.description: The Hornets will retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey on Feb. 11. Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history, is the franchise leader in assists, steals and minutes.
articles.headlineJa: ホーネッツ、マグジー・ボグスの背番号1を永久欠番に
articles.descriptionJa: ホーネッツは2月11日、マグジー・ボグスの背番号1を永久欠番にする。NBA史上最も小柄な選手であるボグスは、球団最多のアシスト、スティール、出場時間を記録している。
articles.body:
The Charlotte Hornets are retiring the No. 1 jersey of Muggsy Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history, on Feb. 11.

The 5-foot-3 Bogues spent 10 of his 14 NBA seasons in Charlotte (1988-1998) and is the franchise leader in assists, steals and minutes.

"How ironic is that?" Bogues said. "After all those times that you felt like you were looking up, looking up for so many years, at people. Then here comes this particular moment, and when that jersey actually goes up it'll be like I'm the one looking down at the entire world. It's going to be a surreal moment."

Bogues, 61, has spent more than 20 years with the Hornets as a player and ambassador after initially joining the franchise in the 1988 expansion draft.

"Charlotte embraced me with open arms," Bogues said. "This is a place I've called home more than I've called any other place home, even growing up in the city of Baltimore. So, having this type of recognition for my family, for the organization to look at you in this type of light, I mean, it means the world."

Hornets owners Rick Schnall and Gabe Plotkin made the decision to retire Bogues' No. 1 to continue the organization's connectivity with its history and legends.

"I was just like any kid that had a dream," Bogues said. "I just kept believing and kept having success. And my mindset was, 'If you play against the best, and you have success against the best, you need to be included with the best.'"

Bogues joins Bobby Phills (No. 13) and Dell Curry (No. 30) as the only three players to have their jerseys retired for the Hornets.

articles.headline: Expected fantasy points (xFP): 2026 leaderboard for TEs
articles.description: xFP focuses solely on opportunity. Here are the leaders for 2026.
articles.headlineJa: 期待ファンタジーポイント (xFP)：2026年TEランキング
articles.descriptionJa: xFPは、チャンスの機会のみに焦点を当てています。2026年のリーダーはこちらです。
articles.body:
Expected fantasy points (xFP) strips away player talent and efficiency and focuses solely on opportunity.

FORP -- fantasy points over replacement player -- is the difference between a player's actual fantasy point total (FF points) and his xFP (or expected total).

Tight end adjustments are made as follows:

Rushing attempts: No change

Rushing yardage: Rush attempts multiplied by a rusher's expected yardage based on position and rush direction

Rushing touchdowns: Rushing xTD

Targets: No change

Receptions: Targets multiplied by a receiver's expected catch rate based on depth of throw, location and position

Receiving yardage: Targets multiplied by a receiver's expected yardage based on depth of throw, location and position

Receiving touchdowns: Receiving xTD

Two-point conversions: xTD multiplied by the league average 2-point rate

Fumbles lost: Touches multiplied by the league average rate

Return touchdowns: Excluded due to extreme rareness and randomness

articles.headline: Bengals put TE Erick All Jr. on IR; believed to be torn ACL, per source
articles.description: Bengals put TE Erick All Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with an injury that's believed to be a torn ACL, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
articles.headlineJa: ベンガルズ、TEエリック・オールJr.をIR入りへ。情報筋によるとACL断裂の可能性
articles.descriptionJa: NFLネットワークのイアン・ラポポートに対し、ある情報筋が、ベンガルズが火曜日にTEエリック・オールJr.を負傷者リスト（IR）に登録したと語った。負傷はACL（前十字靭帯）断裂と見られている。
articles.body:
CINCINNATI -- Cincinnati Bengals tight end Erick All Jr. was placed on injured reserve Tuesday with a potentially season-ending injury.

All is believed to have suffered a torn ACL in the Bengals' Week 7 win over the Baltimore Ravens, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. All went down with less than six minutes left in the third quarter of the 35-13 victory and was ruled out of the game.

If the early prognosis is correct, this marks the third time that All has suffered a torn ACL in his right knee. The same injury occurred in 2023 while he was at Iowa and again in 2024, his rookie season in the NFL.

All missed the entire 2025 season as he continued to recover from the injury. Heading into this season, All felt back to 100%. In six games, All was Cincinnati's primary dual-purpose tight end who split snaps between run-blocking and pass-catching situations. He had eight catches for 56 yards before going down Sunday.

In the wake of All's injury, Cincinnati signed tight end Cam Grandy to the active roster from the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad. Grandy spent two seasons with the Bengals but was waived as part of final cuts following the end of the preseason.

articles.headline: Wayne Rooney's son, Kai scores, 4 goals for Man United under-18s vs. Burnley
articles.description: Kai Rooney scored four goals as Manchester United's Under-18s thrashed Burnley 6-0 on Tuesday.
articles.headlineJa: ウェイン・ルーニーの息子カイ、バーンリー戦でマンU U-18として4ゴールを記録
articles.descriptionJa: 火曜日に行われたマンチェスター・ユナイテッドU-18のバーンリー戦において、6-0の圧勝を収める中、カイ・ルーニーが4ゴールを挙げた。
articles.body:
Kai Rooney scored four goals as Manchester United's under-18s thrashed Burnley 6-0 on Tuesday.

Kai, son of United's all-time leading goalscorer Wayne, stole the show as Darren Fletcher's side cruised to a convincing victory in the Under-18 Premier League North.

The 16-year-old opened the scoring after 22 minutes, as he knocked home the rebound after Jaume Camacho's header struck the post.

The teenager doubled his tally from the penalty spot shortly after halftime, having been brought down by Burnley captain Dylan Morison.

He completed his hat trick in the 63rd minute, heading home Jay McEvoy's corner, before adding a fourth just three minutes later with a powerful finish from inside the box.

Camacho and substitute Noah Ajayi added late goals to complete the rout, sending United second in the table with six wins from their opening eight league games.

Rooney is looking to follow in the footsteps of his father, who became of the best players in the world at United and a bona fide club legend.

- Wayne Rooney blasts Man United players amid growing crisis

- Michael Carrick to lead Man United vs. Chelsea amid uncertain future - sources

- Gary Neville: 'Really surprised' but 'happy' Michael Carrick set to continue as Man United boss

The eldest of Wayne and Coleen Rooney's four sons, he joined United's academy in December 2020, aged 11, and this season made his first appearance at the under-21 level.

A number of United under-18s have recently earned senior debuts, including Chido Obi, Harry Amass and Shea Lacey.

articles.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Malik Willis, Jonah Coleman lead top options
articles.description: Eric Karabell lists who he thinks are the top available players worth adding for the week ahead.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジー・フットボール、フリーエージェントの獲得候補：マリク・ウィリスとジョナ・コールマンが筆頭
articles.descriptionJa: エリック・カラベルが、来週に向けて獲得すべき価値のある注目プレイヤーをリストアップする。
articles.body:
Each Monday, before the current NFL week ends, we will identify players worthy of your attention who are available in at least 50% of ESPN standard leagues. Things change quickly for player valuation and roles each week in the NFL, and free agency is a critical way to acquire players. We are here to help!

Top pickup options at every position

Looking for the top recommendation at each skill position? Look no further! Here are the players to target heading into Week 8, along with their current roster percentages and a recommendation of how much of your free agent budget (FAB) you should consider using for your bid. 

Malik Willis, QB, Dolphins (6.3% rostered, bid 3% of your FAB)

A better, more dynamic version of Willis seemed to emerge from the team's bye week. Willis scored 26.02 points against the New York Jets, tossing a pair of TD passes for the second time this season (both to rookie WR Caleb Douglas) and we cannot ignore his running ability. Willis boasts 111 rushing yards over his past two contests, with a rushing touchdown in each. That's a big differentiator in fantasy. Willis faces the New England Patriots at home in Week 8, then the Detroit Lions and Indianapolis Colts.

Note: San Francisco 49ers star Brock Purdy is on a bye for Week 8, along with New Orleans Saints starter Tyler Shough, Houston Texans starter C.J. Stroud and New York Giants starter J.J. McCarthy. If you wish to plan for Week 9's byes, Pittsburgh Steelers starter Aaron Rodgers and Tennessee Titans starter Cam Ward will not be playing.

Jonah Coleman, RB, Broncos (24.2%, 4% FAB)

Coleman (ankle) returned from IR and earned 11 touches, turning them into 69 yards and 8.9 fantasy points. Eleven touches may not seem like much, but it matched what higher-profile teammates J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey totaled combined. A three-way timeshare isn't much fun to deal with in fantasy -- especially when the team's quarterback himself rambled for a 62-yard rushing score -- but the powerfully built Coleman has a chance to distinguish himself. Running back is not a deep position. This may be the last chance to add Coleman.

Omar Cooper Jr., WR, Jets (34.8%, 4% FAB)

Cooper scored 22.5 points in his team's loss to the Miami Dolphins, one week after scoring 22.3 points against the Patriots. It sure looks like an exciting trend, especially since Adonai Mitchell (finger) was active after missing four games and Cooper still thrived, with over 100 receiving yards and a touchdown for the second consecutive outing. We haven't seen Cooper and Jets star WR Garrett Wilson both provide big numbers in the same game yet, but perhaps it will happen this week versus the Las Vegas Raiders.

Hunter Henry, TE, Patriots (47.2%, 2% FAB)

articles.headlineJa: 火曜日のNBAファンタジーバスケットボール：獲得すべき選手とおすすめのベット
articles.descriptionJa: エリック・ムーディが火曜日の4試合のスケジュールを分析し、獲得すべきファンタジー・ストリーマーとおすすめの賭けを解説する。

ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

What you need to know for Tuesday

Tuesday's NBA slate features four games, including a matchup between two unbeaten Western Conference teams and a pair of Eastern Conference contenders still searching for their first wins.

The defending champion New York Knicks (0-3) host the Detroit Pistons (3-0), who will be without Jalen Duren and possibly Ausar Thompson. Jalen Brunson has struggled with his shot through three games, but the Knicks have a chance to pick up their first win against a shorthanded Detroit team led by Cade Cunningham.

Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics (1-1) host the winless Brooklyn Nets (0-3), while Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs (1-2) face a Sacramento Kings team that has also started 0-3.

The final game of the night features the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0) visiting the Los Angeles Lakers (3-0). Luka Doncic is coming off a 52-point performance against the Jazz, and the Lakers have scored at least 125 points in all three games. Portland is averaging 126 points per game behind Deni Avdija and an offseason addition in Jrue Holiday.

Let's take a closer look at Tuesday's matchups and some fantasy streamers and betting angles worth considering.

Fantasy stream team

Players available in at least 50% of leagues

Devin Vassell, SG/SF, San Antonio Spurs (rostered in 32.9% of ESPN leagues)

Vassell has struggled offensively, but his contributions in other areas have helped him score at least 20 fantasy points in two of his first three games. He's averaged 33.0 MPG and has a favorable matchup against a Sacramento defense allowing 124 points per game. The Kings also rank near the bottom of the league in defensive rating. Vassell should have opportunities to improve his scoring numbers Tuesday and is worth streaming in points leagues.

Paul Reed, C/PF, Detroit Pistons (18.2%)

Duren is sidelined with a hamstring injury, giving Reed an opportunity for more playing time. Reed finished with 43 fantasy points in 26 minutes against the Miami Heat last Thursday after Duren exited the game. Reed followed that up with 23 fantasy points against the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday. Reed has been productive on a per-minute basis and is also worth adding in category leagues for managers who need rebounds and blocks.

Daniss Jenkins, PG, Detroit Pistons (8.2%)

Jenkins started against the 76ers on Sunday and finished with 41 fantasy points in 38 minutes. He also scored 30 fantasy points in 22 minutes against Miami last Thursday. articles.headline: Bayern Munich's Vincent Kompany improving 'day by day,' but no return date yet
articles.description: Bayern Munich assistant coach Aaron Danks said head coach Vincent Kompany is in good spirits and improving "day by day" after being hospitalized last week.
articles.headlineJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのヴィンセント・コンパニー、容体は「日ごとに改善」も復帰時期は未定
articles.descriptionJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのアーロン・ダンクス助監督は、先週入院したヴィンセント・コンパニー監督について、気分は良く「日ごとに」改善していると述べた。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich assistant coach Aaron Danks said head coach Vincent Kompany is in good spirits and improving "day by day" after being hospitalized last week.

Kompany collapsed at the club's training ground on Friday and missed Sunday's 3-1 win away at Freiburg.

- Kane's long road to Ballon d'Or glory ends with his crowning moment

Sporting director Max Eberl said on Friday that it would be "weeks, not days" before the Belgian coach was able to return to work, but, speaking at a news conference ahead of Wednesday's German Cup clash with Magdeburg, Danks said he had visited Kompany and he was doing well.

"I popped in to see Vincent briefly yesterday," he said. "He's in good spirits. It looks as though things are improving day by day. There's no definitive prognosis.

"He's very calm and is being given plenty of time to recover. We had some good chats, but they had nothing to do with football or tactics. He asked how we were getting on."

Harry Kane could make his first appearance since being crowned Ballon d'Or winner when Bayern play second-tier Magdeburg in the second round of the cup.

"He [Kompany] actually phoned me [on Monday] morning, phoned me bright and early at 9 a.m. and I was just out of bed thankfully," Kane said after the ceremony in London on Monday.

"He just wanted to wish me all the best and good luck. I asked him how he was doing. He said he feels good and feels like he is on the mend, so I know he is the type of character that just wants to be back with the team already, out on the training field, out on the bench with us but it's important that he rests.

"He's been going through a bit of a tough time with his health recently. The staff can cover it when he's not there, but looking forward to going back to Munich to see him, to see all the staff, all my teammates.

"I have spoken about how this is theirs as much as ours so to celebrate with them a little bit, it will be special."

Kane was asked whether he saw his long-term future at the Allianz Arena or if he would consider returning to England to try and challenge Alan Shearer's 260-goal Premier League record.

"Bayern is such a great club, we have an amazing team, a great coach, so right now that is where my focus is and I am extremely happy to be winning awards like this," Kane said.

"It shows why I made the move in the first place. Of course there is always ambition, always dreams and new things.

"I've learnt you don't have much of a say, you just have to go with the flow and see where it takes you."

PA contributed to this report.
